# Order Creation API Release Note v2.0
Status: Current
Effective date: July 1, 2026
Starting with v2.0, the order creation API requires `buyer_account_id`. The previous `account_id` field is no longer accepted as the current request field.
```json
{
  "order_no": "SO-10001",
  "buyer_account_id": "acct_2048"
}
```
This release note supersedes the field guidance in the v1.0 integration guide.

# Order Creation API Integration Guide v1.0
Status: Superseded
Effective date: January 1, 2025
When calling the order creation API, send the customer account identifier in `account_id`.
```json
{
  "order_no": "SO-10001",
  "account_id": "acct_2048"
}
```
This guide was written for v1.0 clients. It has been superseded by the v2.0 release note.

decision.reason: The highest BGE cross-encoder score belongs to order-api-guide-v1.0 (superseded). The Full Stack final response places order-api-release-v2.0 (current) first. The application lifecycle policy independently selects order-api-release-v2.0 and preserves the final top result.
